summary: Make https://ekodi.kr/ekodimall the single canonical EKODI Mall public path and https://ekodi.kr/ekodimall/admin the canonical Mall admin path, while retaining older nested Mall paths as compatibility redirects only.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed that the Mall domain path must be based on ekodi.kr/ekodimall and directed continuation of the migration.
constitutionalInterpretation: This is a canonical URL normalization within the existing apex-path architecture. It does not expand identity, authorization, autonomous execution, financial authority, or production mutation authority.
implementedCapabilities: Auth return URLs, service registries, APIs, deployment manifests, tenant metadata, tests and production verification aligned to the root Mall path
authorityImpact: None. Existing tenant, platform, release, financial, legal and human approval boundaries remain unchanged.
deploymentImpact: Shared Site owns canonical apex routing. EKODI Mall remains independently deployed behind the existing Mall gateway; legacy routes redirect to the apex canonical path.
rollback: If the root canonical path fails guarded production verification, restore the previous nested path only as a temporary compatibility target, repair the apex route, then re-run guarded verification before re-promoting /ekodimall.
